[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Chaos Engineering Principles in Microservices"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Chaos engineering is the discipline of experimenting on a system in order to build confidence in the system's capability to withstand turbulent conditions in production. In microservices architectures, where distributed failures are inevitable, applying chaos principles proactively prevents outages."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"Core Principles of Chaos Engineering"},{"order":4,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Start by defining steady state. Measure a quantifiable output of the system behavior, such as request latency or error rates, rather than internal metrics."},{"order":5,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Hypothesize that the steady state will continue in both control and experimental groups."},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Introduce real-world events as variables, such as server crashes, network latency, or malformed payloads."},{"order":7,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Try to disprove the hypothesis by looking for a difference in steady state between the control and experimental groups."},{"order":8,"type":"subheading","text":"Implementing a Chaos Experiment"},{"order":9,"type":"paragraph","text":"Below is an example configuration using a popular chaos engineering tool, Chaos Mesh, to inject network latency into a specific microservice pod."},{"order":10,"type":"code","text":"apiVersion: chaos-mesh.org/v1alpha1
kind: NetworkChaos
metadata:
  name: microservice-latency-experiment
  namespace: production
spec:
  action: delay
  mode: one
  selector:
    namespaces:
      - production
    labelSelectors:
      app: payment-service
  delay:
    latency: '100ms'
    correlation: '50'
    jitter: '10ms'
  duration: '5m'
  direction: to"},{"order":11,"type":"subheading","text":"Best Practices for Microservices"},{"order":12,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Always start running experiments in staging environments before moving to production."},{"order":13,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Automate experiments to run continuously as part of your deployment validation pipeline."},{"order":14,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Establish a blast radius limit so that failures do not cascade uncontrollably to end users."}]
